title: What is IELTS?

display.layout: hero + purpose tiles + recognitions + background accordion

highlights.heading: The name
highlights.text: IELTS stands for International English Language Testing System.

highlights.heading: Four language skills
highlights.text: The test measures Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

highlights.heading: Why people take it
highlights.text: IELTS is used to demonstrate English ability for study, work and some migration pathways.

highlights.heading: Recognition
highlights.text: Universities, employers and other organizations use IELTS results, although acceptance requirements differ.

highlights.heading: Requirements vary
highlights.text: Always check the exact test type and minimum score required by the institution or authority you are applying to.

highlights.heading: Partners
highlights.text: IELTS is associated with the British Council, IDP and Cambridge English organizations.
